rows.note: This is the all-purpose name for Satan himself.

example.english: The religious textbook says Satan is the devil who tempts people into sin.
example.traditional: 宗教課本話撒旦係引誘人犯罪嘅魔鬼。
example.jyutping: zung1 gaau3 fo3 bun2 waa6 saat3 daan6 hai6 jan5 jau5 jan4 faan6 zeoi6 ge3 mo1 gwai2

rows.note: Use this when Satan is presented as the chief or king of demons, especially in religious or fantasy contexts.

example.english: You have to beat the devil before you can finish the game.
example.jyutping: daa2 jing4 mo1 wong4 sin1 ho2 ji5 baau3 gei1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a devil or Satan-like evil being.

example.english: The devil uses people's greed to lead them astray.
example.traditional: 魔鬼會利用人嘅貪心，引佢哋走上歧途。
example.jyutping: mo1 gwai2 wui5 lei6 jung6 jan4 ge3 taam1 sam1 jan5 keoi5 dei6 zau2 soeng5 kei4 tou4

rows.note: Use this for an explicitly evil demon, especially in more formal contexts, while 魔鬼 is the everyday default.

example.english: The devil in this film symbolizes the darkest side of human nature.
example.traditional: 呢套電影入面嘅惡魔，象徵住人性最黑暗嘅一面。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 ge3 ok3 mo1 zoeng6 zing1 zyu6 jan4 sing3 zeoi3 haak1 am3 ge3 jat1 min6
